hebrew: וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
translation:
And there was a king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

Jewish Publication Society 1917 translation (public domain)
information:
